commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin"
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-general-audit.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/repo"
cd "$WORK/repo"
echo "AUDIT_SHA|$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "BRANCH|$(git branch --show-current)"
echo "CLEAN|$(test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "SERIAL_120_PRESENT|$(test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-120 && echo yes || echo no)"
for days in 7 30 90; do echo "COMMITS_${days}D|$(git log --since="${days} days ago" --format=%H | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; done
echo "LAST_SEVEN_DAYS_FILES"
git log --since="7 days ago" --name-only --format= | sort -u | grep -v '^$' | sed -n '1,60p'
echo "TOOL_VERSIONS"
for name in python3 cmake clang-format clang-tidy pnpm node idf.py; do if command -v "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s|%s\n" "$name" "$(command -v "$name")"; else echo "$name|MISSING"; fi; done
echo "PACKAGE_PYTHON_STATUS"
if test -x .venv/bin/python; then echo "PYTHON_VENV|present"; else echo "PYTHON_VENV|absent in clean clone"; fi
echo "READ_ONLY_GATES"
set +e
make test-ipo > "$WORK/test-ipo.log" 2>&1
result=$?
echo "TEST_IPO_EXIT|$result"
tail -35 "$WORK/test-ipo.log"
python3 -m compileall -q tools scripts > "$WORK/compile.log" 2>&1
result=$?
echo "PYTHON_COMPILE_EXIT|$result"
tail -12 "$WORK/compile.log"
if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd web && pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile && pnpm gate) > "$WORK/web.log" 2>&1; result=$?; echo "WEB_GATE_EXIT|$result"; tail -35 "$WORK/web.log"; else echo "WEB_GATE|SKIP missing pnpm"; fi
echo "END_AUDIT_READ_ONLY"
